subject: ISO/FedRAMP convergence: scope, artifacts, and timeline questions
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acmecorp.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial artefact request and timeline questions for ISO/FedRAMP

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. As part of our vendor security intake, we have a couple of follow-ups that will help our InfoSec team align Redwood's profile to our procurement timeline. Attached is a short questionnaire (PDF) with a few SIG/CAIQ items called out, plus a separate sheet listing ISO-27001 Annex A controls we track. Our immediate asks: 

- Can you confirm your ISO 27001 scope (in-scope systems / exclusions)? We need a short descriptive scope statement for our compliance team.
- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II SysDesc or control evidence that maps to Annex A controls? If so, which artifacts are available for review?
- Rough timeline: what is your estimate to reach FedRAMP Moderate readiness (if you’ve previously scoped this)? Any milestones we can align to?

If it helps, we can split answers between a short written response and a 30-min follow-up call next week. Attached: Acme-questionnaire-request.pdf.

Would appreciate a response by end of week if possible — procurement deadline is mid-June.

Thanks,
Jordan Myers
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Corp

Attachment: Acme-questionnaire-request.pdf (1 page)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acmecorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial artefact request and timeline questions for ISO/FedRAMP

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. Quick summary up front, and we’ll follow with specifics and artifacts: 

- ISO 27001 scope: Production inference platform (API, model serving runtime, control plane) hosted in our cloud regions. Excludes customer-managed on-prem components. I’ll provide a one-paragraph scope statement for your records.
- SOC 2 SysDesc: we maintain a current system description and control evidence sets; we can share the SysDesc and selected evidence bundles under an NDA/secure link.
- FedRAMP readiness: we have a FedRAMP scoping exercise underway; realistic estimate to be assessment-ready for Moderate is ~9–12 months from a firm resourcing commitment. If you need an internal gap estimate, we can provide a short breakdown of high-priority controls.

Next steps I propose: Karthik will attach the ISO scope matrix draft and proposed owners. Evelyn will attach the current SysDesc and a CAIQ draft. After you review, we can schedule a 30-min call to walk the gaps and agree on a mutual action plan.

I’ll also add a link to a shared drive for artifact delivery.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance & Trust | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (555) 321-9876

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acmecorp.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial artefact request and timeline questions for ISO/FedRAMP

Laura / Jordan — adding a bit more color from the infra side. Attaching the draft scope matrix for ISO that maps services to controls and proposed owners. High-level notes: 

- In-scope: API gateway, serving runtime (GPU hosts), control plane services (model registry, routing), client-facing telemetry pipelines.
- Out-of-scope: customer-managed on-prem deployments and customer model data stored in customer VPCs.
- FedRAMP: previous scoping work suggests most gaps are in continuous monitoring and fine-grained IAM logging for the control plane; both are engineering projects but not blockers. With prioritized workstreams (logging, CM, vulnerability mgmt), we estimate a 9–12 month timeline to assessment readiness for Moderate — assuming headcount or contractor support for remediation.

Action items I can execute this week: 
- Share redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (attached)
- Draft a short ISO scope statement (one paragraph) for Laura to review
- Identify owners for top 5 remediation items and attach a rough ETA

Evelyn — can you confirm which SysDesc package we’re comfortable sharing externally (full SysDesc vs. redacted bundle)? Jordan — if NDA is required for full artifacts, flag it and we’ll route through the secure SharePoint link.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (workbook, 3 sheets)
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

I have uploaded the files to the shared drive link below (redacted link in thread metadata). If you need the full evidence bundles, please confirm an NDA or secure transfer; otherwise we’ll share a redacted evidence package containing the SysDesc and control excerpts.

Laura / team — received, thanks for the quick turn. I downloaded the SysDesc and CAIQ draft and the scope matrix looks good to me. A couple quick notes before our call: 

- We’ll likely need a short redacted evidence bundle for procurement immediately (logs + SysDesc excerpts). Please indicate which artifacts you can share without an NDA.
- For FedRAMP: the 9–12 month estimate aligns with our internal modeling. We’d like to see a prioritized remediation plan for the top 5 control gaps during the kickoff call.

Can we schedule a 30-min slot Friday 2026-05-22 at 10:00 AM PT to walkthrough the matrix and agree mutual next steps? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite (below is a meeting link).
